name: quorum
description: On request, run a structured debate between agent CLIs (claude, codex, agy, grok) and your configured API or local models, with the models and effort you pick.

interface.shortDescription: Debates between claude, codex, agy and grok
interface.longDescription: Ask Quorum to put a question to several agent CLIs at once. They research read-only in your project and on the web, debate in structured phases, and return a synthesis with consensus and remaining disagreements.
defaultPrompt: Have Quorum debate this design decision.
Get a deep Quorum second opinion on this plan.
Run a quick Quorum on which option is better.
